description: Source code for the F1 Application Protocol (F1AP) setup procedure in a 5G network, implementing the F1 setup request, response handling, retries, and context updates.

classes.name: f1ap_du_setup_procedure
classes.description: Handles the F1 setup procedure including request sending, response processing, retries, and context management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine executing the setup procedure, managing retries and timing.

methods.name: send_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Constructs and sends the F1 setup request message to the CU.

methods.name: retry_required
methods.description: Determines if a retry is needed based on the response and retry count.

methods.name: validate_f1_response
methods.description: Validates the response PDU type for success or failure.

methods.name: create_f1_setup_result
methods.description: Creates and returns the result of the setup procedure based on the transaction response.
